jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT PLENFUL

Plenful is on a mission to transform healthcare operations from the inside out. Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our technology empowers healthcare operators across hospital and health systems, pharmacies and payors to eliminate manual work, reduce administrative burden, and improve compliance, all while unlocking critical revenue to fund programs for their in-need patient populations.


Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Plenful is hiring a Business Operations Associate to help build the internal systems and processes that enable our company to scale. This is a generalist role for someone who enjoys structuring ambiguous problems, working across teams, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

Initial ownership will include:

 - Managing employee-facing IT operations, including devices, software, access, vendors, and day-to-day support.

 - Improving company knowledge management, including Notion structure, governance, and documentation.

 - Leading high-priority cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation.

The role reports to our Chief of Staff & VP, Business Operations and will evolve as Plenful’s needs grow.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Identify manual, fragmented, or unclear processes and use technology, automation, and AI to make them more efficient and scalable.

 - Maintain and improve Plenful’s workplace and IT systems, including tool administration, permissions, documentation, and operating processes.

 - Lead cross-functional operational projects by defining problems, aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and implementing durable solutions.

 - Strengthen company knowledge management by improving Notion organization, governance, templates, and content discoverability.




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - 3–5 years of experience in Business Operations, Strategy & Operations, consulting, startup operations, or a similarly cross-functional role.

 - Strong systems thinking and creative problem-solving skills.

 - Ability to structure ambiguous problems and independently drive work to completion.

 - Strong project management, analytical, and written communication skills.

 - Technical fluency and comfort learning and managing workplace tools and systems.

 - High ownership, attention to detail, and willingness to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

 - Collaborative, low-ego approach and ability to work effectively across teams.

 - High-growth technology experience preferred; healthcare or regulated-industry experience is a plus.


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

 - 🚀 Mission-Driven, World-Class Team — Join an exceptional group of professionals aligned around a meaningful mission and committed to making an impact

 - 📈 Opportunities for Growth — Strengthen your expertise through collaboration with experienced, high-performing leaders across the organization

 - 🏢 Flexible Hybrid Work Environment — We're remote-first, with meaningful office presence in San Francisco and New York. R&D roles follow a hybrid model, with two days per week in our San Francisco office


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - 🏥 Healthcare Coverage — Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and participation for your family

 - 💰 401(k) with Company Match — Plenful matches 50% of your first 3% contributed

 - 📊 Equity — Every full-time employee shares in our success

 - 🌴 Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need, when you need it

 - 🍽️ Daily Lunch Stipend — $100/week to cover your midday meals

 - 💪 Wellness Stipend — $100/month to support your health and well-being

 - 🚇 Commuter Benefits — $100/month for SF and NYC-based employees

 - 👶 Parental Leave — Paid leave to support growing families

jobs.title: VP, Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT PLENFUL

Plenful is on a mission to transform healthcare operations from the inside out. Fresh off our $50M Series B and backed by Notable Capital, Bessemer Venture Partners, TQ Ventures, Susa/Kivu Ventures, and other leading investors, we’re building the category-defining AI automation platform that healthcare teams rely on to operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Our technology empowers healthcare operators across hospital and health systems, pharmacies and payors to eliminate manual work, reduce administrative burden, and improve compliance, all while unlocking critical revenue to fund programs for their in-need patient populations.


Built by healthcare operators for healthcare operators, Plenful is driven by a deep understanding of the challenges facing today’s care teams. We’re passionate about equipping healthcare workers with world-class tools that deliver real, measurable impact, and we’re proud to serve 100+ leading health systems, pharmacies, and healthcare organizations across the country. If you’re excited to help shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to meet you. Apply now to join our growing team.



We're looking for a VP of Finance to run strategic finance and accounting at Plenful. Reporting to the CEO, you'll own the operating plan, the forecast, and the economics behind every major resourcing decision the leadership team makes.



This is a hands-on role at a company that is scaling quickly. You'll inherit a current, well-run accounting function and an AI-driven finance stack that's already in place. Your job is to take both further.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the plan. Annual operating plan and rolling forecast, built on active multi-scenario models leadership actually uses to commit to hires and investments.

 - Own capital allocation. Bring a recommendation, not a menu. Where each million $ is invested, what it has to return, and what we stop doing.

 - Own the economics. Unit economics, S&M and R&D investments, gross margin by product, and the pricing and deal structures that move them.

 - Be the partner leaders want in the room. Go-to-market, product, engineering, and operations leaders should bring you the decision before it's made, not the invoice after.

 - Own leadership and board reporting. Weekly, monthly and quarterly metrics leadership runs on.

 - Build the decision layer. Our core systems are already in place. Mature the processes and strategic decision making running on top of them.

 - Build the team. Lead, coach, and grow the strategic finance and accounting team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 8+ years in finance, including running finance or FP&A at a high-growth AI B2B SaaS company through Series B scale and beyond.

 - A track record of taking a high functioning finance team to the next level of rigor: sharper forecasting, active scenario modeling, management reporting leadership relies on

 - Player-coach. You build the model yourself and you develop the people who will eventually own it

 - Solid technical accounting foundation, including ASC 606 revenue recognition on complex or milestone-based contracts.

 - Proven transaction experience required. Supporting a financing round, an acquisition, an IPO, or a similar diligence process from the finance leadership seat.

 - A sharp business partner. You’re comfortable having hard conversations with other leaders while maintaining strong relationships.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, high ownership, low ego

 - Healthcare, regulated-industry, and AI-native experience is a plus


WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

 - 🚀 Mission-Driven, World-Class Team — Join an exceptional group of professionals aligned around a meaningful mission and committed to making an impact

 - 📈 Opportunities for Growth — Strengthen your expertise through collaboration with experienced, high-performing leaders across the organization

 - 🏢 Flexible Hybrid Work Environment — We're remote-first, with meaningful office presence in San Francisco and New York. R&D roles follow a hybrid model, with two days per week in our San Francisco office


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - 🏥 Healthcare Coverage — Full medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and participation for your family

 - 💰 401(k) with Company Match — Plenful matches 50% of your first 3% contributed

 - 📊 Equity — Every full-time employee shares in our success

 - 🌴 Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need, when you need it

 - 🍽️ Daily Lunch Stipend — $100/week to cover your midday meals

 - 💪 Wellness Stipend — $100/month to support your health and well-being

 - 🚇 Commuter Benefits — $100/month for SF and NYC-based employees

 - 👶 Parental Leave — Paid leave to support growing families

ABOUT THE ROLE

Plenful is hiring a Customer Success Account Manager to join our growing Customer Experience team. You'll work closely with our Head of Customer Experience to shape how we handle implementation, support, retention, and expansion — with enough scope to touch nearly every part of the company along the way. You'll partner across technical, commercial, and executive teams, and grow with the role as the company scales. This is a remote position.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Customer Satisfaction — Monitor account health indicators, run usage and ROI analysis, lead business reviews, and visit customers on-site.

 - Customer Relationship Management — Serve as the primary point of contact starting at implementation kickoff. Build relationships that last.

 - Project Management — Oversee customer implementations for new use cases and work closely with our technical team on back-end configuration.

 - Expansion Opportunities — Spot and pursue contract expansion by understanding customer needs and matching them to what Plenful offers.

 - Communication Excellence — Set the standard for clear, responsive, professional customer interactions, and improve how we communicate internally about customers.

 - Strategic Optimizations — Lead data-driven analysis that helps us serve customers better and scale our processes.
   


YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

 - You've spent 3+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Enterprise Sales, Management Consulting, or a related field — ideally in SaaS or healthcare technology.

 - You've managed customer relationships, driven adoption, hit retention goals, and grown accounts.

 - You know your way around CRM and customer success platforms like Salesforce.

 - You can read data and turn it into ROI numbers, decisions, and recommendations.

 - You've run projects across multiple stakeholders and hit deadlines without dropping the ball.

 - You write and speak clearly, and can influence stakeholders at every level.

 - You solve unstructured problems with a customer-first mindset.

 - You're organized enough to manage multiple accounts and prioritize independently.

 - You're genuinely interested in healthcare and making the industry work better.

 - You're comfortable in a fast-moving, still-being-built environment, and can travel up to 25% of the time.

 - Bonus points for early-stage startup experience, familiarity with healthcare regulation (HIPAA, 340B, Prior Auth), and a BA/BS degree.
